title: Measured derived collections use memoization
intent: Add an expensive pure React derivation
guidance: Wrap a measured expensive pure derivation in useMemo with its complete dependency list.

title: Components use semantic design tokens
intent: Add visual styling to a component
guidance: Reference role-based design tokens for component color and spacing instead of introducing literal values.

title: Feature state lives behind a view model
guidance: Keep transitions and injected dependencies in the feature view model while exposing immutable state to the view.

title: User-facing copy comes from the message catalog
guidance: Store translatable copy under a stable catalog key and reference that key from feature code.

title: API handlers use the shared error envelope
intent: Add an API endpoint with failure responses
guidance: Map domain failures through the repository response helpers so clients receive the established error envelope.

title: HTTP clients use the shared retry policy
guidance: Use the shared bounded retry helper and explicit timeout instead of implementing an unbounded local retry loop.

title: Repositories parameterize dynamic SQL values
guidance: Keep SQL structure static and pass every dynamic value through the database driver's parameter interface.

title: Cache keys include tenant identity
intent: Cache data owned by a tenant
guidance: Build cache keys from both tenant identity and resource identity using the shared key helper.

title: Operations emit structured logs
guidance: Use the shared structured logger with stable event names and fields instead of interpolated prose.

title: Terraform resources merge common tags
guidance: Merge the module common tags with stable resource-specific tags on every supported resource.

title: Services expose startup and health probes
guidance: Configure startup, readiness, and liveness probes using the repository service defaults.

title: Data pipelines validate boundary schemas
guidance: Validate required fields, types, and units at the ingestion boundary before transforming records.

title: Scientific values carry explicit units
guidance: Name, validate, and convert physical units explicitly at module boundaries before calculation.

title: Background work supports cooperative cancellation
guidance: Thread the repository cancellation signal through background work and clean up acquired resources on cancellation.

title: Tests use the shared fixture builder
intent: Add test data for a domain entity
guidance: Start from the shared valid fixture builder and override only fields relevant to the behavior under test.

title: Documented commands are executable
intent: Add a command to user documentation
guidance: Present a complete copyable command using current flags and verify it against the shipped CLI.
